The Activity 4 heading h2#a4-h now reads "Assignment copies a reference, not an object", the scoped heading the finding recommended. It is correct: for a reference-typed variable, simple assignment stores the right-hand value, a reference, into the variable (JLS SE 25 15.26.1), and many references may point to the same object (JLS SE 25 4.3.1); it makes no claim about how objects are created. The teaching sentence "For your own classes, only new creates an object" is unchanged and stays scoped. A tolerant search (only.{0,20}new) of artifact.html and artifact.md finds no other unscoped rule: the Activity 2 lane feedback "Declaring a class creates no object; only `new` does." contrasts a class declaration with new for the Lamp class, and the Activity 4 feedback counts new expressions in the given lines. artifact.md carries no activity headings.
